Every ci run since 14d7ea0 (bfce2d0 ... cfcf600) is still `queued`, for example 40512552904, where every job is queued.
findings.problem: M18.118 made a pending run hold a red one only when it declares `Fixes-ci`, and bounded the wait by LAST_CI_MAX_PENDING (4) and LAST_CI_MAX_WAIT_MS. Both rules sit only in the `done` branch. Once the red completed run scrolls out of the 30-run window, the `if (!done)` branch prints 'no completed run' and leaves verdict at 0. A stack of more than about 10 pending pushes on a red main therefore turns last-ci green, and that is the state of main right now. drive/next-task read exit 0 as 'main's CI is not red' and start feature work. This is the cp12 F2 failure mode again (a pending run hides red), now through the window and not through the wait branch. M18.128 (unreadable state is unknown) does not cover it, because gh answered.
findings.suggestion: Treat 'no completed run among N pending' as unknown or red once N exceeds LAST_CI_MAX_PENDING. Or read the newest completed run per workflow directly (`gh run list --workflow <wf> --status completed --limit 1`, or REST `?status=completed`) so the window cannot hide it. Add a runs-file test with 5 or more pending ci runs and no completed one that expects a non-zero exit.
